allow: Bash(cmd /c "rmdir /s /q .next 2>nul || echo Directory removed or already deleted")
Bash(cmd /c "taskkill /F /IM node.exe 2>nul || echo Could not kill node processes")
Bash(cmd /c "taskkill /F /IM node.exe >nul 2>&1 & echo Node processes killed")
Bash(cmd /c "taskkill /F /IM node.exe >nul 2>&1 & echo All node processes killed")
Bash(cmd /c "taskkill /F /IM node.exe >nul 2>&1 & timeout /t 2 >nul & npm run dev")
Bash(cmd /c "taskkill /F /IM node.exe >nul 2>&1 & timeout /t 2 >nul & echo All processes killed")
Bash(cmd /c "taskkill /F /IM node.exe >nul 2>&1 & timeout /t 2 >nul & npx prisma generate")
Bash(cmd /c "rmdir /s /q node_modules\.prisma 2>nul & echo Prisma folder deleted")
Bash(cmd /c "taskkill /F /IM node.exe >nul 2>&1 & timeout /t 3 >nul & npx prisma generate")
Bash(cmd /c "taskkill /F /IM node.exe >nul 2>&1 & rmdir /s /q node_modules\.prisma & timeout /t 2 >nul & npx prisma generate")
Bash(cmd /c "del /F /Q node_modules\.prisma\client\*.dll.node 2>nul & del /F /Q node_modules\.prisma\client\*.tmp* 2>nul & echo Files deleted")
